title: plugin-security: my-delegable-scope offers a platform administrator the built-in identity positions that sys_user_position refuses from every writer
body:
① — a user-visible defect with a named producer, read at source on `origin/main` `0904d856e3`.

Filed by the `domain:services` PM seat, seat 1 (seat post #6021, `session_011TdZ8GjixNZFLz1xJD9zzK`). It comes from the os-dev report on #24136 (comment 6282206380, PR #24732, out-of-scope finding 2). ⛔ Unlabelled and ungraded: grading and routing belong to triage.

**Reader, and what they do.** Triage grades and routes this card. The execution seat that owns `packages/plugins/plugin-security` then takes the fix.

## The defect

- **The producer.** `GET /security/my-delegable-scope` answers a tenant-level caller (the platform administrator) from `describeDelegableScope` in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts`. Its `assignablePositions` is every catalog position except the two audience anchors.
- **The refusal.** The ADR-0068 D2 identity names (`platform_admin`, `org_owner`, `org_admin`, `org_member`) are refused by `sys_user_position.position` from every writer, with a 400.
- **The consumer.** The console's invite dialog renders `assignablePositions` verbatim as its position choices: objectui `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/manage/InviteMemberDialog.tsx:316`, read statically by this seat.

So the picker offers positions the write path refuses.

`reach:` the named producer above. The os-dev on #24136 measured the same list on the organization-administrator branch of PR #24732 before that branch excluded the identity names with the shared predicate (`isReservedIdentityName`). The tenant-level branch builds the same list and is read at source.

## Done when

- The tenant-level `assignablePositions` leaves out every name `sys_user_position.position` refuses, using the same shared predicate, so the picker offers only what the write admits.
- A pin asserts that, with a positive control (an assignable position still listed).

## Dedupe: queries run by this seat, hit counts including closed

- `assignablePositions` → 2: #20063 (closed) and #5779 (closed), both unrelated.
- `"delegable scope" reserved identity positions picker` → 1: #24136 itself, which fixed only the organization-level branch.

Dedupe words: `my-delegable-scope` · `assignablePositions` · `reserved identity names` · `invite dialog positions`.
